records.rule: Classic patients has no registration actor/creator/user column and no patient-to-users relationship.
patients.registered_by is nullable user FK with ON DELETE SET NULL.
registered_by=null plus protected provenance that no source actor was evidenced.
Current user, first user, administrator, importer/system operator and department supervisor are all prohibited.
Legacy Actor Unknown is prohibited for patients.registered_by and patient_aliases.created_by.
Must return through Phase 2B verified employment plus exact registration-role semantic approval; FK compatibility is insufficient.
Null registrar does not block an otherwise valid patient because target permits null.
All created patients have null registrar and protected absence record; every prohibited fallback counter is zero.
